items.titleZh: Why Voice AI Still Needs a Screen | Pavan Muddireddy
items.summary:
Ordering food by voice alone is harder than it sounds: without a menu in front of you, you have to hold every item in your head while you decide. Pavankumar Reddy Muddireddy, who leads audio research at Mistral AI, uses that example to explain why he expects voice to sit on top of a screen rather than replace it. The screen lets you take in information quickly and gives you proof that the system did what it said.

Watch the full conversation with Pavan:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ixu0H8bsCts

items.summaryOriginal: The Tokenizer is a necessary and pervasive component of Large Language Models (LLMs), where it translates between strings and tokens (text chunks).
